summary: Verified the label-print bug fix (PrintPreview.js now prints via a self-contained hidden iframe). Ran a Playwright flow: login (admin@dukkanim.com/admin123) -> Dashboard -> select products -> qty inputs -> Tam Etiket / Yarım Etiket previews -> Yazdır. All acceptance criteria pass. The previous iter1 id/_id bug is confirmed fixed (products now return real 'id' values; product-row-<realId> testids present). No console errors during the entire flow.
verified_acceptance_criteria: Login flow works and dashboard loads with 7 seeded products (real ids returned by /api/products).
select-all-checkbox selects all rows -> 7 qty-input-<id> render with real ids.
print-full-button with NO selection -> preview NOT opened AND toast 'Lütfen en az bir ürün seçin' shown.

print-full-button with selection opens overlay with do-print-button, close-print-button and print-label items. First selected product with qty=3 produced 3 labels; total 9 labels for 7 rows (3+1+1+1+1+1+1). Labels show name + price in ₺ (e.g. '110" MANDALLI DİŞİ KAFA' / '550,00 ₺').

Yazdır (do-print-button) does NOT call window.print on the parent window (window.__parentPrintCount stayed 0 after clicks). A hidden iframe is created for printing and cleaned up after ~1.5s. Verified for BOTH Tam and Yarım.

Kapat (close-print-button) closes the overlay (verified once the top-right login-success sonner toast dismissed; a stale sonner toast was intercepting the button in the first automated attempt but that is a test-timing artifact, not an app bug).
print-half-button opens Yarım Etiket Önizleme with 4-column layout and 50×30mm · 36/sayfa header.

Pagination: qty=20 with Tam -> '20 etiket · 2 sayfa (A4) · 100×30mm · 16/sayfa' and 20 rendered label divs. qty=40 with Yarım -> '40 etiket · 2 sayfa (A4) · 50×30mm · 36/sayfa' and 40 rendered label divs.
Regression: login toast 'Giriş başarılı', search filter (query returns 'Ürün bulunamadı.' for no-match), product list, qty inputs, select all all functional. No uncaught console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: PrintPreview.js: doPrint() timing (setTimeout 350ms before print, 1500ms before cleanup) works in practice but there is no load listener on the iframe. Consider using iframe.onload = () => { iframe.contentWindow.print(); iframe.onafterprint = cleanup; } for correctness on slower browsers/printers.

PrintPreview.js: There is no removal safeguard if print dialog blocks synchronously; the fixed 1500ms setTimeout may remove the iframe before the browser has spooled the job in rare cases. Not observed here.

Dashboard.js: confirmDelete uses deleteTarget._id (line 124) but products now expose 'id' -- so deletion may be broken. iter1 tests deleted products via API. This should be verified in the UI: click delete-button-<id> and press delete-confirm-button. (Not in this iteration's scope of testing, but reported.)
Dashboard.js: ProductDialog key uses editing?._id (line 400) -- same _id vs id inconsistency as delete. Should be editing?.id.
Backend server.py (from iter1): startup uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'); consider FastAPI lifespan handlers. Not blocking.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for print bug-fix acceptance; potential regression on delete/edit due to _id usage — not exercised this iteration

seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds 6+ Turkish products on startup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Print bug fix is verified end-to-end. If E1 asks for a follow-up regression pass, please explicitly exercise Dashboard delete flow (click delete-button-<id> then delete-confirm-button) and edit flow (edit-button-<id> then save) because Dashboard.js still references deleteTarget._id (line 124) and editing?._id (line 400) even though the API now returns 'id'. That is the last remaining _id/id inconsistency from the iter1 refactor.
rca of the issue: Not applicable — bug fix verified. Original bug (window.print on parent) is resolved by moving printing into a hidden self-contained iframe (PrintPreview.doPrint). Parent window.print counter remained 0 across both Tam and Yarım print attempts.
